QuestInfo.name: Loong Abandoned
QuestInfo.0: Chan the Golden Temple Guard seems to know something about Master Loong's whereabouts.
QuestInfo.1: Chan knows where Master Loong is. There is a path that leads to an #bAbandoned Underground Temple#k under #m252010300#.\nChan said that Master Loong went inside not long ago and prohibited anyone else from entering. If you can eliminate #b100 #o8144003##k monsters, Chan will consider letting you pass.\nGet into the #rAbandoned Temple#k and find #bMaster Loong#k.
QuestInfo.2: Chan knows where Master Loong is. There is a path that leads to an #bAbandoned Underground Temple#k under #m252010300#.\nChan said that Master Loong went inside not long ago and prohibited anyone else from entering. If you can eliminate #b100 #o8144003##k monsters, Chan will consider letting you pass.\nAs requested, you cleared up the monsters and met with #b#p9000073##k at #b#m252020000##k.

0.0: Anyway, back to #p9000073#. I already told you he passed by without so much as a nod, but it's my job to stop tourists, not monks, so I let him through without making a fuss.
0.1: See that entrance just a little ways down the path? It leads to the #bAbandoned Underground Temple#k, which is where Master Loong went. Now, if YOU wanted to follow him... Well, you'd have to do me a little favor first.

yes.0: A #b#o8144003##k stole a meso out of my pocket while I was standing around just minding my own. It's the principle of the matter, you know? Now, they all pay! Eliminate #b100#k of them. 'Course, you're not to tell anyone about our little deal.

no.0: Fine. Suit yourself. TURN AROUND. You're not allowed to be here. You like that?

1.0: You! What are you doing down here? This place is much too dangerous for you! \r\n#L0##bYou must be Master Loong. Somchai sent me to look for you.#l\n#k
1.1: Ah, my little ducklings miss me. Yes, I'm indeed Loong. You tell them I miss them, too, but my job here is not yet complete.

yes.0: It is my duty to stay here and finish my task. It is how I can protect my ducklings.

npc.0: A #b#o8144003##k stole a meso out of my pocket while I was standing around just minding my own. It's the principle of the matter, you know? Now, they all pay! Eliminate #b100#k of them. 'Course, you're not to tell anyone about our little deal.
